note: Kosovo: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90 days in any 6 months; everyone else needs a visa (holders of a Schengen multiple-entry visa or residence may enter for 15 days: not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Ministry's list on its archive site (undated): it confirmed the 90 days within six months and 105 of the passports held, but doesn't name Bosnia and Herzegovina (exempt from 1 January 2025, later than the list), Hong Kong, Macao, Singapore, Taiwan or Slovenia (it names Slovakia twice, a slip for Slovenia), so those stand on Wikipedia's copy; the current list wasn't found.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Kosovo
sources.said: Citizens of the following countries and territories may enter Kosovo without a visa for up to 90 days within any 6-month period: All European Union member states Albania Andorra Antigua and Barbuda Argentina Australia Bahamas Bahrain Barbados Belize Bosnia and Herzegovina Botswana Brazil Brunei Canada Chile Colombia Costa Rica Dominica El Salvador Eswatini Fiji Grenada Guatemala Guyana Honduras Hong Kong Iceland Israel Japan Jordan Kiribati Kuwait Lesotho Liechtenstein Macau Malawi Malaysia Maldives Marshall Islands Mauritius Mexico Micronesia Monaco Montenegro Namibia Nauru New Zealand Nicaragua North Macedonia Norway Oman Palau Panama Papua New Guinea Paraguay Qatar Saint Kitts and Nevis Saint Lucia Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Samoa San Marino Sao Tome and Principe Saudi Arabia Serbia Seychelles Singapore Solomon Islands South Africa South Korea Switzerland Taiwan Timor-Leste Tonga Trinidad and Tobago Turkey Tuvalu Ukraine United Arab Emirates United Kingdom United States Uruguay Vanuatu Vatican City Venezuela
